findings: All acceptance criteria met. Build passes (exit 0), lint clean (0 warnings), tsc --noEmit clean (exit 0). Key notes: (1) API routes use Prisma.CourseWhereInput / Prisma.ResourceWhereInput types for type-safe dynamic filtering. (2) All API routes return [] on DB error, never crash with 500. (3) /api/health and /api/ready include db_status field. (4) All public pages have export const metadata, Navbar, Footer, and EmptyState for no-data cases. (5) Dynamic pages ([boardSlug], [classSlug], [subjectSlug], [slug], [examSlug]) all have generateMetadata. (6) src/app/sitemap.ts returns static routes + dynamic DB routes (graceful on DB unavailability). (7) src/app/robots.ts disallows /api/, /student/, /teacher/, /parent/, /admin/. (8) public/manifest.json and public/sw.js created. (9) layout.tsx updated with next/font/google (Inter + Outfit) as CSS variables, manifest link, theme-color meta, and production-only SW registration script. (10) tailwind.config.js updated to use CSS variable font references. (11) JSON-LD added: Organization schema on homepage, FAQPage on /faq, Course schema on /courses/[slug]. (12) During static build, DB-dependent API routes gracefully return [] (Prisma errors caught) — this is expected behavior as DATABASE_URL is not set in build CI.
